vertical-spacing.description: No matching --ct-tabs-vertical-spacing resolved value exists in civictheme.variables.css — tabs.twig's vertical_spacing prop is implemented upstream via the shared, not-yet-ported 00-base/spacing utility (.ct-vertical-spacing-inset--*), whose base step is ct-spacing(3) = 8px * 3 = 24px (1.5rem) below the `l` (992px) breakpoint, doubling to ct-spacing(6) = 48px (3rem) at/above it. Value computed directly from that SCSS source (packages/sdc/components/00-base/mixins/_spacing.scss + spacing.scss's $ct-spacing-map), not invented — matches the resolved value basic-content.json/iframe.json already use for the exact same shared utility.

links-stripe-border-color.description: No matching --ct-tabs-light-links-stripe-border-color resolved value exists in civictheme.variables.css even though tabs.css itself references var(--ct-tabs-light-links-stripe-border-color) — the compiled upstream variables file is simply missing this entry (verified: grepped the full file, present for every other *-links-* tabs token). Resolved to color.light.highlight (not invented) by pattern-matching every other component's own '*-stripe-*' token in this repo's tokens tree (accordion, fieldset, callout, next-step, event-card, promo-card, service-card, fast-fact-card all alias their stripe color to color.*.highlight) — flagged per the 'no matching token found' fallback rather than treated as a normal reconciled lookup.
Same missing-upstream-token situation as the light-theme entry above (see that description) — resolved to color.dark.highlight by the same sitewide stripe-color pattern.
